record.original_question: Let Psi_{2n} be the convex set of 2n x 2n symmetric doubly stochastic matrices with zero diagonal whose extreme points are the adjacency matrices of perfect matchings in K_{2n}. For each 2 <= k <= n, determine or give a good general lower bound for mu_{k,n} := min_{B in Psi_{2n}} haf_k(B), where haf_k(B) is the k-haffnian of B.

evidence.quote: Let Psi2n subset Omega2n,s,0 be the convex set of symmetric doubly stochastic matrices with zero diagonal, whose extreme points are the adjacency matrices of perfect matches in K2n.
Our problem is to find or give a good lower bound for min_{B in Psi2n} haf_k(B) = mu_{k,n} for k = 2, . . . , n.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K_{2n}$ denote the complete graph on $2n$ vertices. For a $2n\times 2n$ symmetric matrix $B=(b_{ij})$ with zero diagonal, and an integer $k\ge 1$, define the $k$-haffnian of $B$ by
$$\operatorname{haf}_k(B) \;=\; \sum_{(M_1,\dots,M_k)} \prod_{t=1}^{k}\prod_{\{i,j\}\in M_t} b_{ij},$$
where the sum is taken over all ordered $k$-tuples $(M_1,\dots,M_k)$ of perfect matchings of $K_{2n}$ (so for $k=1$ this reduces to the usual hafnian).

Let $\Psi_{2n}$ be the convex hull, inside the space of symmetric matrices, of the adjacency matrices of the perfect matchings of $K_{2n}$. Equivalently, $\Psi_{2n}$ is the set of symmetric doubly stochastic $2n\times 2n$ matrices with zero diagonal whose extreme points are exactly the adjacency matrices of perfect matchings of $K_{2n}$.

For each integer $k$ with $2\le k\le n$, define
$$\mu_{k,n} \;=\; \min_{B\in\Psi_{2n}} \operatorname{haf}_k(B).$$

Determine $\mu_{k,n}$, or establish a good general lower bound for $\mu_{k,n}$, valid for all $2\le k\le n$.
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches return general background on hafnians, permanents of doubly stochastic matrices, and the Egorychev–Falikman (van der Waerden) theorem, but no specific result determining or giving a sharp lower bound on $\mu_{k,n}=\min_{B\in\Psi_{2n}}\operatorname{haf}_k(B)$ for $k\ge 2$. It is known that no nontrivial lower bound exists for the ordinary hafnian ($k=1$ case), but the multi-matching version for $k\ge 2$ does not appear to have been resolved in the accessible literature.

status_evidence.snippet: Hafnians count perfect matchings of weighted graphs; bounds for hafnians of nonnegative symmetric matrices are studied.
status_evidence.claim: General background on hafnians; no specific resolution of the k-haffnian minimum on Psi_{2n}.

status_evidence.title: Doubly stochastic matrix — Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Egorychev and Falikman proved van der Waerden's conjecture on the minimum permanent of doubly stochastic matrices.
status_evidence.claim: Analogous permanent result is known, but no analogous theorem for k-haffnians on Psi_{2n} is reported.
